title: TTT shared writable basis with private residual rank
hypothesis: A shared rank-4 writable TTT basis plus small per-stream private residuals reaches full-state online quality at lower actual bytes; increasing residual rank identifies the storage threshold for sequence-specific directions.
physical_object: Shared TTT initialization and four rank-4 output modes
mirror_coordinate: Per-stream code selects a shared mode; private residual state spans orthogonal sequence-specific output directions
logical_multiplicity: 16 online linear learners with private writable rank 0/2/4/8

task.metric: Prequential NLL/MSE and last-32-token MSE; actual serialized state bytes; update MACs

controls: Shared dictionary code plus per-stream private residual rank r
Native dictionary ID plus identical private residual factorization
Independent private rank-(4+r) basis per stream upper control
success_gate: At some residual rank r, shared+private state reaches <=1.10x full TTT last-window MSE and <=60% of full-state bytes on both development seeds. Report where private residual becomes necessary. Mirror-specific success additionally requires a strict gain over native dictionary IDs.
failure_gate: No rank meets quality/storage gate, or exact native dictionary-ID alias without strict Mirror-specific gain. Keep fresh seeds sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic supervised TTT-like online linear regression
Private directions are orthogonal to shared modes and fully serialized
